name: Impact speed ramp
description: Play the action at natural speed, briefly decelerate through the moment of contact, then smoothly return to natural speed without repeating the action.

prompt.default: Play the action at natural speed, briefly decelerate through the moment of contact, then smoothly return to natural speed without repeating the action.
prompt.kling: Play the action at natural speed, briefly decelerate through the moment of contact, then smoothly return to natural speed without repeating the action. Apply the speed change to the subject's motion, without a camera cut.
prompt.seedance: Play the action at natural speed, briefly decelerate through the moment of contact, then smoothly return to natural speed without repeating the action. Keep the speed transition continuous within one shot.
prompt.veo: Play the action at natural speed, briefly decelerate through the moment of contact, then smoothly return to natural speed without repeating the action. Show a smooth temporal transition with consistent subject identity.
prompt.wan: Play the action at natural speed, briefly decelerate through the moment of contact, then smoothly return to natural speed without repeating the action. Gradually vary action speed with continuous subject motion.
